summary: Verified plan v5 (design-only, 5 milestones, 22 steps, 2 blocked, 130 acceptance tests of which 48 are checkers) on all three lenses across all 22 steps and verified it: 0 blockers, 6 warnings. The single v4 blocker B01 is closed and reproduced -- the Case org-wide default now lives on M1-S01's objects/Case/Case.object-meta.xml as <sharingModel>Private</sharingModel> plus <externalSharingModel>Private</externalSharingModel>, M2-S05's check_sharing_model.py runs at --manifest-dir artefacts with scope 'build' declared to match, and a fixture run resolves 1 object OWD where the v4 form resolved 0. All six v4 warnings are dispositioned and the four closable ones were reproduced rather than accepted: --strict now makes the REVIEW blank-guard finding blocking on both check_validation_rules.py commands (guarded exits 0, unguarded exits 1 with --strict and 0 without); the check_case_management_setup.py order dependence is gone, confirmed by running the identical build-scope command with M3-S04 present and absent and getting exit 0 both ways, with two matched negatives at exit 1; D4's Q13 branch quote is now the whole block, verbatim. M1-S01's human_gate flip to true is correct and mandated -- agents/build-planner/AGENT.md:274 lists org-wide defaults among the changes that require a gate, and this agent's own testability table refutes an access-changing step without one; set-plan added the pending step:M1-S01 record on the same write. The six warnings are documentation defects that break no step: four false library-state claims about two checkers (each contradicted by another passage in the same plan), one assumption link the B01 move left behind, and one milestone goal left standing beside three tests that were reworded away from it. 22 checker commands, 8 matched negatives and 4 controls were executed this session against a fixture built from the cited skills' own metadata examples. validate exits 0 with the same three documented non-standard-argument-form warnings before and after this run's write. No gate approved, nothing deployed, nothing written outside the build directory.
confidence_rationale: All three lenses ran on all 22 steps and every verdict names a file read or a command run; no verdict rests on a missing file. MEDIUM rather than HIGH for two reasons. The grounding lens's Questions-to-Ask and gotchas checks were targeted -- the skills every v5 change touches, plus the source of every checker whose behaviour the plan asserts -- rather than exhaustive across all 36 cited skills. And every checker verdict rests on this agent's own reconstruction of correct artefacts from references/metadata-examples.md, so a checker that passed here could still fail on what metadata-builder actually writes. Not LOW: build_plan.py and the schema were available, mechanics validate at exit 0 identically before and after the write, and every one of the six warnings rests on a reproduced command output or a quoted line of source rather than on an absent file.
